I farm this wheat plot with my family and we own the land, so I want to invest in it properly. Wheat needs fertilizer to yield well on our soil, so I will buy DAP and urea through the cooperative, though I cannot afford the full recommended package — I will apply what I can. I keep seed from last year's harvest since improved wheat seed is expensive and not always available at our kebele. For weeding and harvest I will call on one or two neighbors for a few days, but most of the work my family will do ourselves.
